text:
harper: follow-up on allocator refactor: we need a cheap way to hint 'keep these allocations together' across offload boundaries without touching every small alloc
jin: can we piggyback on existing headers? adding fields hurts tiny allocs.
elie: proposal: two-tier approach: arena opt-in tokens (4B) + probabilistic sidecar mapping for default arenas. sidecar keyed by coarse bucket (64KB) -> token
harper: sidecar read on free, cheap atomic read of a few-word map. writes only on sampled allocs or opt-in arenas
jin: what about checkpointing? Dedicated customers expect behavior after restart
elie: persist only active buckets snapshot every 30s. on restart unlabeled buckets are cold until warmed; no blocking rebuild
ops-bot: perf-smoke: allocator-lineage branch passed ci (alloc-lineage/ci#314)
harper: affinity semantics: token is a soft placement hint. admission uses token to prefer the same host pool but allows spill under pressure. add affinity weight config (default 0.25)
jin: need safety: max concurrent lineage moves per node to avoid compaction storms. also grace window for staged rehomes
elie: agree. heuristics: mark groups, schedule staged moves over N seconds, throttle global compactions if many moves in-flight
harper: telemetry owners? I'd like metrics: sampled_allocs, sidecar_hits, lineage_group_moves, lineage_compacted_bytes
jin: i'll add config flags: arena_enable_lineage, sampling_rate, bucket_size, affinity_weight, max_concurrent_moves
elie: long-term idea: extend token semantics to model-shard affinity for kv-caches. separate RFC later
harper: next steps: land opt-in flag + sidecar sampler, admission hook, checkpointing, telemetry. sync Friday to review perf sims
jin: +1
elie: +1
ops-bot: note: please attach perf traces to the PR for review
